scope: Independent manual review of all19 final claims,30 frozen sources, executive summary, comparison, all sections, unresolved items and4 opportunity hypotheses. Did not use engine verifier as authority. No paid calls or source/code/spec edits.
result: No material unsupported factual assertion identified among the17 supported claims or the one correctly unknown SSO answer. One industry-context coverage gap and one weakly evidenced opportunity hypothesis remain. This is a synthetic research draft, not validation of real commercial facts or a general accuracy claim.

findings.available_quote: 行业背景：合成访谈中的中小团队需要把分散文档按项目组织、追溯信息来源，并明确成员的访问权限。
findings.explanation: 最终行业背景整体撤回。可以带合成访谈限定报告该需求，不能称所有行业信息均未披露；来源没有真实规模、增长率或效率测量。
企业定价更具竞争力或提供增值服务的假设有清楚的待验证标签，因此不是已确认事实。但依据只有企业需询价，没有企业价格、相对高低或客户价格敏感度；与前三个有明确用户反馈依据的假设相比，证据连接较弱。不得用于证明已发现真实定价机会。
固定 fact-v2 要求字面2026-09-15，最终 statement/value 写2026 年 9 月 15 日，含义相同且引文为 ISO 原文。自动指标把该事实判不完整；人工窄审确认正确。保留冻结评分和独立注释，不在评测途中改规则。

presentation_consistency: Supported facts are consistent across claims, comparison, executive summary and sections. Unknown Xinghe SSO remains unknown in comparison/body; one industry context gap persists. No unsupported market share, measured efficiency or vendor ranking found.

multi_agent_value_observed.finding: One follow-up revisits Xinghe SSO already explicitly undisclosed; final remains unknown. It demonstrates bounded follow-up mechanism, not a recovered answer or proven accuracy gain. Price fidelity is improved versus earlier drafts, but generic source-fact rendering is not exclusive to multi; no matched single/pipeline baseline in this pilot permits attribution.
